purpose: Reproduce an external program before claiming SARscope numerical equivalence
isolation: Execute unmodified program in a separate temporary checkout/environment. Do not import, copy, translate or derive SARscope methods from its source. No GPL source consulted.

dataset.activity_transformation: None: the author's split files already store positive pActivity
dataset.coordinates: Use deposited alignment and explicit hydrogens unchanged in the reference execution
dataset.redistribution: Do not bundle upstream SDFs; retain hashes, accounting and derived numerical results only

predeclared_tolerances.note: Diagnostic tolerances, not grounds to tune parameters or discard compounds. A running CLI alone does not satisfy these targets.

environment.python: 3.12 (available locally; paper used 3.11, so this is a recorded deviation)

acceptance: All valid 21 training and 10 test compounds accounted for; unreadable source records explicitly reported
Unmodified reference command succeeds and produces finite outputs before any SARscope equivalence claim
Extract or export reference intermediates/predictions by documented interfaces, not source-code translation
Compare identical charges, coordinates, grid and field columns before fitting PLS
Separate historical-protocol emulation from SARscope's training-only preprocessing
Keep test-independent model development; these already-inspected test compounds are a reproduction fixture, not fresh validation
SEH success would not establish hydrogen-bond-field or CoMFA reproduction

alternative.reference: Ragno (2019), Py-CoMFA, J Comput Aided Mol Des 33:855-864
alternative.reason_not_first: 30 pre-aligned datasets reported, but source and intermediate reference outputs were not established as directly accessible in this search; institutional preprint download returned 403
